title: structural uniform operator-Lipschitz bound for the robust first-order surrogate (family 5b)
parent_gate: read-only reuse of Family 5's verified API (base_scene/build_poses/smooth_AB_of_flat_X and its scene config); Family 5 was not rerun and no existing file was changed
environment_note: Apple Silicon CPU, no GPU/MPS/CUDA; deterministic seeded numpy/scipy linear algebra

config.pose_theta_convention: theta = atan2(-p_y, -p_x): body +x axis points toward the origin
config.randomness_note: family5 is deterministic under fixed numpy default_rng seeds 2718, 4242, 5150, 9191 (recorded per use); dense numpy/scipy linear algebra
config.title: structural uniform operator-Lipschitz bound for the robust first-order surrogate (family 5b)

family5b_seeds.note: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); directions normalised to unit 2-norm on R^18

config.norm_conventions: input norm on R^18 is the Euclidean 2-norm; output norms are Frobenius for A/K matrices and spectral (||.||_2) for P, B, C^-1; JA_op = largest singular value of J_A (m_A x q) as a matrix, JB_op = largest singular value of J_B (m_B x q)
config.nonlinearity_note: full-model samples use the exact smooth_AB_of_flat_X nonlinear map; the A and B Jacobians used in L_struct are centred finite differences at the evaluation point

seeds_family5.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); directions normalized to unit q-norm

derivation.objective: K(X) = A(X)^T P(X) A(X), P = I - B (B^T B + alpha I)^{-1} B^T, alpha = 1.0 >= 0. Norms on matrix outputs are Frobenius unless stated; pose perturbations are measured with the Euclidean 2-norm on R^18.
derivation.step1_directional_derivative: D_d K = A^T dP A + dA^T P A + A^T P dA (product rule on A^T P A).
derivation.step2_frobenius_triangle_bound: ||D_d K||_F <= 2||A||_F ||dA||_F + ||A||_F^2 ||dP||_2, using ||dA^T P A||_F <= ||dA||_F ||P||_2 ||A||_F and the identical A^T P dA term, and ||A^T dP A||_F <= ||A||_F^2 ||dP||_2.
derivation.step3_P_projection: P is symmetric with eigenvalues 1 - s_i^2/(s_i^2 + alpha) on the range directions of B (plus unit eigenvalues); hence ||P||_2 <= 1 for alpha >= 0.
derivation.step4_C_inverse: C = B^T B + alpha I satisfies sigma_min(C) >= sigma_min(B)^2, so ||C^{-1}||_2 <= 1/sigma^2 with sigma = sigma_min(B). alpha = 1 actually makes sigma_min(C) ~ 1 + sigma^2; the requested general alpha >= 0 bound is used for the derived constant.
derivation.step5_dP: d(C^{-1}) = -C^{-1} (dB^T B + B^T dB) C^{-1} gives dP = -dB C^{-1} B^T - B C^{-1} dB^T + B C^{-1} (dB^T B + B^T dB) C^{-1} B^T.
derivation.step6_dP_norm_bound: ||dP||_2 <= 2||dB||_2 (tau/sigma^2 + tau^3/sigma^4), with tau = ||B||_2: the first two terms each cost ||dB||_2 tau ||C^{-1}||_2 <= ||dB||_2 tau/sigma^2 and the third costs at most tau ||C^{-1}||_2 (2 tau ||dB||_2) tau ||C^{-1}||_2 = 2||dB||_2 tau^3/sigma^4.
derivation.step7_operator_norms: With ||dA||_F <= JA_op ||d|| (JA_op = sigma_max(J_A)) and ||dB||_2 <= JB_op ||d|| (JB_op = sigma_max(J_B)), the pointwise structural Lipschitz constant is L_struct = 2||A||_F JA_op + 2||A||_F^2 JB_op (tau/sigma^2 + tau^3/sigma^4).
derivation.affine_certificate: For the affine model A_aff(d) = A0 + J_A d, B_aff(d) = B0 + J_B d, the ingredients on the radius-eps ball are bounded by A_max = ||A0||_F + JA_op eps, tau_max = tau + JB_op eps and sigma_min(B_aff) >= sigma_min_aff = sigma - JB_op eps (valid while positive). Substituting these in the same derivation yields L_cert_affine(eps) = 2 A_max JA_op + 2 A_max^2 JB_op (tau_max/sigma_min_aff^2 + tau_max^3/sigma_min_aff^4). The affine map is Lipschitz on the whole ball with this constant, so ||K_aff(d) - K_aff(0)||_F/eps <= L_cert_affine(eps) and, by Weyl, |lambda_min(K_aff(d)) - lambda_min(K_aff(0))|/eps <= L_cert_affine(eps) for every unit d.
derivation.full_model_validation: The exact nonlinear K(X0 + eps d) is sampled at 500 unit directions for eps in {1e-3, 3e-3, 1e-2} and its observed quotients are compared with L_struct at X0 and with a sampled ingredient envelope computed at 5 boundary points X0 + 1e-2 d.

certification_status.affine_tangent: RIGOROUS certificate FOR THE AFFINE MODEL ONLY, conditional on the numerically computed FD Jacobians J_A, J_B being exact to machine precision (supported by the O(h^2) h-convergence checks); holds on the radius-eps ball while sigma_min_aff > 0
certification_status.full_nonlinear: DERIVED structural bound with sampled ingredient envelope; NOT a formal interval certificate; every violation/slack is reported exactly
certification_status.global_certification: No claim of global certification of the nonlinear Helmholtz/smooth model is made
certification_status.fd_Jacobians: finite-difference estimates with recorded h1/h2 and O(h^2) convergence checks, not machine-precision exactness proofs

scope_note: Finite-dimensional whitened/realified dense linear algebra on the validated Family-1 Jacobians with the shared smooth p=24 basis and alpha=1.0; structural Lipschitz statements are pointwise/sampled as described and are scenario-specific
